items.name: Ring World Site
items.desc: This complex will serve as a staging ground, resource depot and living quarters for the hundreds of thousands of personnel involved in the Ring World's construction.

items.name: Ring World Frame
items.desc: This initial skeletal frame encircles the system's sun, and serves as the platform on which we will eventually build fully habitable sections.

items.name: Ring World Frame Section
items.desc: This skeletal frame section makes up roughly one quarter of the unfinished Ring World's total surface area. Work on the smaller habitable section has not yet been completed.

items.name: Completed Ring World Section
items.desc: A fully functional habitable Ring World section, complete with an active biosphere, that is ready for settlement.

items.name: Ruined Ring Section
items.desc: This section of the Ring World once supported a functional biosphere, but no longer. Repairs are theoretically feasible, but it would require advanced technology and a large amount of resources.

items.name: Completed Ring World Section
items.desc: A fully functional habitable Ring World section, complete with an active biosphere, that is ready for settlement.

items.name: Dyson Sphere Site
items.desc: The construction site station serves as the base for the future construction of a Dyson Sphere.

items.name: Dyson Sphere Frame
items.desc: The frame is the foundation for the future Dyson Sphere and does not generate any energy.

items.name: Dyson Sphere: Initial
items.desc: A partially operational Dyson Sphere - §Y25%§! energy generation efficiency.

items.name: Dyson Sphere: Medial
items.desc: A partially operational Dyson Sphere - §Y50%§! energy generation efficiency.

items.name: Dyson Sphere: Penultimate
items.desc: A partially operational Dyson Sphere - §Y75%§! energy generation efficiency.

items.name: Dyson Sphere
items.desc: A fully operational Dyson Sphere - §G100%§! energy generation efficiency.

items.name: Ruined Dyson Sphere
items.desc: A ruined Dyson Sphere, shattered beyond any possible repair.

items.name: Ruined Dyson Sphere
items.desc: A ruined Dyson Sphere. Despite its age, the megastructure's basic frame is largely intact. With the necessary technology and vast amounts of resources, the sphere could potentially be repaired.

items.name: Dyson Sphere
items.desc: A fully operational Dyson Sphere - §G100%§! energy generation efficiency.

items.desc: It produces no energy. Only beauty.

items.name: Sentry Array Site
items.desc: The construction station serves as the base for the future assembly of a Sentry Array.

items.name: Sentry Hub
items.desc: A state-of-the-art listening post crewed by a permanent staff of astronomers and tactical analysts.

items.name: Sentry Spire
items.desc: Oscillating fins arranged along a central spire isolate faint signals from ever-pervasive background radiation.

items.name: Sentry Aerials
items.desc: Massive, static antennas provide an unprecedented boost to raw coverage.

items.name: Sentry Array
items.desc: A complete Sentry Array extends sensor range to cover the entire galaxy.

items.name: Ruined Sentry Array
items.desc: The shattered remnants of what was once an extremely powerful Sentry Array. This megastructure has been ruined beyond repair.

items.name: Ruined Sentry Array
items.desc: The shattered remnants of what was once an extremely powerful Sentry Array. Despite its age, the megastructure's antennas are, for the most part, structurally intact. With the right technology and a large amount of resources, the array could potentially be restored to working order.

items.name: Sentry Array
items.desc: A complete Sentry Array extends sensor range to cover the entire galaxy.

items.name: Science Nexus Site
items.desc: This initial site will serve as the base for the future construction of a Science Nexus.

items.name: Science Nexus Hub
items.desc: Equipped with a state of the art singularity reactor, the central core will cover most of the Nexus' energy needs. It will also connect the future research facilities.

items.name: Science Nexus Research Wings
items.desc: The research wings will contain most of the labs and provide housing for the scientists. They come with multiple security chambers to allow for complete lockdown of various areas, if necessary.

items.name: Science Nexus
items.desc: A fully equipped and operational Science Nexus.

items.name: The Groik Nexus
items.desc: Named after its inventor, this Science Nexus has a neural bank containing the brain of one of our finest researchers integrated into its main drive, allowing it to operate at an increased speed.

items.name: Ruined Science Nexus
items.desc: This ruined Science Nexus is little more than an empty hulk. Its main hull has been damaged beyond repair.

items.name: Ruined Science Nexus
items.desc: A ruined Science Nexus. Although its insides were stripped clean by looters eons ago, the megastructure's main hull is still mostly intact. With the right technology and a lot of resources, it could potentially be refurbished.

items.name: Science Nexus
items.desc: A fully equipped and operational Science Nexus.

items.name: Gateway Site
items.desc: The initial site will serve as the base for the construction of a future Gateway.

items.name: Gateway
items.desc: A conduit through the very fabric of subspace that enables rapid travel to other Gateways.

items.name: Disabled Gateway
items.desc: The ancient remains of what appears to be a Gateway of some sort. If repaired, this structure could enable starships to rapidly travel to other functional Gateways.

items.name: Matter Decompressor Site
items.desc: The construction site station serves as the base for the future construction of a Matter Decompressor: Anchor.

items.name: Matter Decompressor: Anchor
items.desc: An advanced gravity redirection engine holds the facility base on the edge of the black hole's event horizon.

items.name: Matter Decompressor: Lensing
items.desc: The gravity lensing facility redirects a portion of the black hole's gravitational force, concentrating it even more strongly in a selected area.

items.name: Matter Decompressor: Boring
items.desc: The ultimate refinement of the gravity redirection system forms a focused area of twisted gravity, creating a vast drill whose bore is made of redirected and concentrated gravitational force.

items.name: Matter Decompressor
items.desc: With a bore of twisted gravity tunneling into the singularity and a series of automated matter decompressors, processors, and smelters in orbit, we are able to extract minerals from a black hole.

items.name: Ruined Matter Decompressor
items.desc: An orbital station in severe disrepair, this Matter Decompressor once skirted natural law by reclaiming matter from the black hole in this system. It is now damaged beyond all repair.

items.name: Strategic Coordination Center: Hull
items.desc: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center houses the cream of our military command, who devote their time to strategy and planning in this state-of-the-art facility.

items.name: Strategic Coordination Center: Comms
items.desc: Powerful communication arrays have been added to the Strategic Coordination Center, enabling our strategists to issue unjammable, unhackable orders to our ships throughout the galaxy.

items.name: Strategic Coordination Center
items.desc: With the final addition of detached Hostile Force simulation bastions, the Strategic Coordination Center is the definitive megalith of national security and military planning.

items.name: Ruined Strategic Coordination Center
items.desc: The remains of an ancient military comms station. The damage is severe enough that repairs are impossible.

items.desc: The initial framework for the Mega Shipyard lays the basis for what will one day be the most productive shipyard in the galaxy.

items.name: Mega Shipyard Core
items.desc: The core of the Mega Shipyard contains much of the infrastructure required to move and process the vast quantities of materials needed to supply the production berths.

items.name: Mega Shipyard
items.desc: With a multitude of ship-production berths supplied from a hyper-efficient processing core, the Mega Shipyard's output eclipses that of any other Starbase.

items.name: Ruined Mega Shipyard
items.desc: This utterly ruined shipyard will never again build ships. It has been damaged beyond repair.

items.name: Ruined Mega Shipyard

items.name: Quantum Catapult Site
items.desc: This compact supply depot gathers all the materials and personnel necessary to construct the first batch of vast focusing lenses for the Quantum Catapult.

items.name: Quantum Catapult Single Array
items.desc: Calculations have shown that even a scant few torsion lenses, installed at precise locations around their star, can channel enough energy to enable semi-volatile trajectories across interstellar space.

items.name: Quantum Catapult Twin Arrays
items.desc: Twin arrays of torsion lenses are placed diametrically opposite each other in order to improve the channeling of stellar flux as a means of transportation.

items.name: Quantum Catapult
items.desc: A linked cage of torsion lenses around the star ensures optimal throughput from the energy being captured to its release as a means of interstellar transportation.

items.name: Ruined Quantum Catapult
items.desc: This arrangement of vast lenses was designed to focus energy from the star it encompasses. Such an energy source would be powerful enough to launch ships across interstellar space - if only the array weren't so misaligned, and in clear need of repair.

items.desc: A manifest violation of the laws of the universe, this ship possesses reality editing capabilities. It is designed to pierce the event horizon of a black hole and plunge into the heart of the singularity, where infinite density begets infinite gravity.

items.name: Ruined Synaptic Lathe

items.desc: The Galactic Crucible has been irreversibly re-engineered to prevent dangerously high energy output. It will remain a stable and secure source of prosperity for the empire.
